note: A0 is Marzi's internal pre-A1 label, not an additional CEFR certification. A level setting changes opportunity difficulty; it does not by itself prove a learner's level.

bands.opportunityDesign: Supported recognition and very short fixed or chosen chunks; one concrete purpose or detail at a time.
Simple predictable one-step exchange using familiar words and short clauses.
Routine multi-turn exchange, basic reasons and details, and simple repair or alternatives.
Connected explanation and handling of a realistic complication or negotiation.
Flexible, detailed interaction under multiple constraints with appropriate register and repair.
Precise, efficient, nuanced interaction with implicit meaning, complex constraints, and sustained coherence.
